name: @quarry/code-workspace-server
description: The Code Workspaces service (docs/design/architecture-split.md, phase 4): workspaces, their Git repositories over HTTP, sessions and check runs, in a process of its own, on its own database login. Datasets through Catalog's microservice calls, recipes through Forge's, tokens through Identity's. Browsers and sessions reach it through the main server; its worker calls its /internal endpoints directly.

scripts.dev: nodemon -w src -w ../../../platform/kernel -w ../../../libraries/shared -e ts,json --exec ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
